lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters posterior to the gills are arranged in roughly vertical columns; inter-centroid spacing is consistent vertically but shows slight longitudinal expansion toward the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with primary horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like rectilinear pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, defined by high-luminance upper edges and shadowed lower margins, running parallel to the longitudinal axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains a sparse distribution of approximately 12 high-luminance blobs, primarily concentrated in the basal and central regions of the fin.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the gill slits displays a significantly higher density of micro-spots compared to the discrete, larger blobs found on the lateral flank.
